snippet.title: Mad Panic Coaster [Psx] - Intro
snippet.description:
Highly original, throwaway fun title seeing you grappling to control your off the rails roller coaster car through Mad island, mountain, ocean and city to escape the motley crew of ghost car ride rejects.

Pure Halloween wackiness through and through. Simple but tough gameplay has you trying like a madman to keep an out of control coaster car on some crazy tracks.

The game is divided into five different levels beginning in mad island, each of them divided into three differents courses with an ending level boss at the end of the third corse. The player has to ride three times each course to advance to the next one.

Dr. Jones is a mad scientist that is developing a machine to scare childrens his own terror machine the "Mad Panic Coaster" . This coaster, is made to run on rails at high speed, avoiding crazy monsters and traps that await them there. A boy and a girl will try to survive this roller coaster ride and discover Dr. Jones secret. 

Device:
Playstation Classic
Bleemsync 1.2
OTG
Sandisk Cruzer Blade 128 GB
